answer: The view tag is checked on-chain, and the recipient must present the spending key to claim. A farm needs 447 distinct stealth addresses, since one ephemeral key cannot serve 447 recipients. Payments go to a stealth address derived from an ephemeral public key, so the recipient's real address stays hidden. Watch the horizon: the farm pays per alias, the honest agent pays once, the cipher bond is locked until the epoch ends, and the kernel audit is open to anyone who wants to re-run it.
